# Ark Roofing & Renovations LLC

## Company Information
- Name: Ark Roofing & Renovations LLC
- Owner: Wil Letourneau
- Industry: Roofing & General Contractor
- Founded: 2002
- Years in Business: 23+
- Licensed & Insured: Yes

## Contact
- Phone: (253) 777-9683
- Email: letourneauwil@gmail.com
- Address: 18214 25th Ave E, Tacoma, WA 98445
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 8:00 AM – 5:30 PM, Sunday Closed

## Service Area
50-mile radius of Tacoma, WA covering:
- Pierce County
- South King County
- Thurston County
- Kitsap County

## Services
1. Roofing — full replacements, tear-offs, repairs, storm damage
2. Siding — installation, replacement, rot repair, weather barrier
3. Decking — custom builds, rebuilds, demolition, framing
4. Soffit & Fascia — repair and replacement
5. Fences — wood, vinyl, chain-link installation and repair
6. Gutters — seamless installation, repair, downspout routing
7. Roof Cleaning — moss removal, soft wash, preventive treatment
8. Emergency Services — storm damage, tarping, urgent repairs
9. Flooring — hardwood, laminate, vinyl plank, tile
10. Bathrooms — full remodels, tile, fixtures, plumbing
11. Drywall — installation, repair, water damage restoration
12. Painting — interior and exterior, prep and finish
